Package aor.proj3t.daos.impl

Class EvaluationDAOimpl

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.daos.impl.AbstractDAO<Evaluation,Long>
aor.proj3t.daos.impl.EvaluationDAOimpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
BasicDAO<Evaluation,Long>, EvaluationDAO
public class EvaluationDAOimpl extends AbstractDAO<Evaluation,Long> implements EvaluationDAO
Stateless EJB implementation of the EvaluationDAO interface.

This class provides concrete implementation for managing evaluation records within the performance management system. It extends AbstractDAO to leverage common CRUD operations and implements specialized functionality for evaluation lifecycle management, status tracking, and complex business queries.

Key implementation features:

  • Multi-dimensional evaluation filtering by cycle, evaluator, and participant
  • Status-based evaluation lifecycle management and workflow control
  • Complex JPQL queries for evaluation analytics and reporting
  • Criteria API implementation for dynamic filtering capabilities
  • Bulk operations for status updates and evaluation processing
  • Date range querying for temporal evaluation analysis
  • Relationship traversal across evaluation cycles and user hierarchies

Transaction Management: Critical operations utilize @Transactional annotations to ensure data consistency during multi-step evaluation processes and status transitions.

    • closeAllCompletedEvaluations

      public int closeAllCompletedEvaluations()
      Closes all evaluations that have been completed but not yet closed.

      This bulk operation updates the status of all evaluations that are in a completed state to closed. This is typically used during cycle closure or administrative cleanup operations.

      Implementation notes: Executes a bulk update operation to transition all evaluations with COMPLETED status to CLOSED status. This method supports evaluation lifecycle management and cycle finalization processes. The transactional annotation ensures atomicity of the bulk operation.

      Performance note: Uses JPQL UPDATE for efficient bulk processing without requiring individual entity loading and modification.

      Specified by:
      closeAllCompletedEvaluations in interface EvaluationDAO
      Returns:
      The number of evaluations that were successfully closed

    • getEvaluationsByFilters

      public List<Evaluation> getEvaluationsByFilters(EvaluationFilter filters)
      Retrieves evaluations based on complex filtering criteria.

      This method provides advanced querying capabilities using a filter object that can specify multiple criteria such as status, date ranges, evaluator, and other evaluation properties.

      Implementation notes: Implements comprehensive multi-criteria filtering using JPA Criteria API with sophisticated relationship traversal and dynamic query construction. This method provides extensive filtering capabilities including:

      • Entity filtering: By evaluation ID and participant relationships
      • User filtering: Evaluator and evaluated user identification
      • Cycle integration: Evaluation cycle relationship handling
      • Status management: Evaluation and cycle status filtering
      • Temporal filtering: Date range evaluation selection
      • Dynamic sorting: Configurable field and direction-based ordering

      The method utilizes INNER JOIN operations for evaluation cycle relationships to ensure data consistency and enable cycle-based filtering operations. Predicates are constructed dynamically based on non-null filter values, optimizing query performance by including only necessary conditions.

      Performance considerations:

      • INNER JOIN operations optimize relationship traversal
      • Predicate lists are pre-allocated for efficient memory usage
      • Conditional query building reduces unnecessary database load
      • Enum comparisons handle status filtering with type safety
      Specified by:
      getEvaluationsByFilters in interface EvaluationDAO
      Parameters:
      filters - The filter criteria to apply. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      A List of evaluations matching the filter criteria, or an empty list if no matches are found

      public List<Evaluation> findByEvaluatedAndStatusIn(User evaluated, List<EvaluationStatus> statuses)
      Retrieves evaluations for a specific evaluated user filtered by status.

      This method finds all evaluations where the specified user is being evaluated and the evaluation has one of the specified statuses. Useful for employee self-service portals and performance tracking.

      Implementation notes: Utilizes JPA Criteria API to construct a dynamic query for finding evaluations based on specific user and status combinations. This method supports flexible evaluation lookup with multiple status filtering, enabling complex business scenarios such as finding all active, pending, or completed evaluations for a particular user.

      Uses the IN clause for efficient multi-status filtering and entity comparison for user-based lookup.
